metadata.description: Spec writes goal documents; Seal carries a goal to recorded completion.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Turn an idea or change into goal documents with stable completion criteria that any coding agent can implement. The user or the host agent can call it; Ready and the start of implementation come only from the user's words. With nothing left to decide it asks whether to implement now, and the user's yes starts it; a separate implementation request still works.

plugins.name: seal
plugins.description: Carry a goal document to recorded completion: the agent plans, implements, and verifies, and completion is declared only from Seal Core run records.

plugins.name: spar
plugins.description: Run independent review rounds on pinned commits with several reviewer CLIs, classify their findings, and record a review gate the agent can stop on.
